task: Create a new calendar event for my team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour.
utility_reason: task_success: A new ICS calendar file `team_meeting_2026-08-19.ics` was created for a Team Meeting on next Wednesday from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM, matching the requested one-hour event.

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import datetime, uuid
print('DTSTAMP:', datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'))
print('UID:', str(uuid.uuid4()))
"

python3 -c "
content = open('team_meeting_2026-08-19.ics').read()
lines = [l.strip() for l in content.splitlines() if l.strip()]
required_open = lines.count('BEGIN:VCALENDAR') == 1 and lines.count('END:VCALENDAR') == 1
vevent = lines.count('BEGIN:VEVENT') == 1 and lines.count('END:VEVENT') == 1
has_uid = any(l.startswith('UID:') for l in lines)
has_dtstamp = any(l.startswith('DTSTAMP:') for l in lines)
has_dtstart = any(l.startswith('DTSTART') for l in lines)
has_dtend = any(l.startswith('DTEND') for l in lines)
has_summary = any(l.startswith('SUMMARY:') for l in lines)
print('Calendar container OK:', required_open)
print('VEVENT container OK:', vevent)
print('UID present:', has_uid)
print('DTSTAMP present:', has_dtstamp)
print('DTSTART present:', has_dtstart)
print('DTEND present:', has_dtend)
print('SUMMARY present:', has_summary)
print('--- File content ---')
print(content)
"
